name: Norm Thornley
story: Norm Thornley was geospatial services manager in the Department of Conservation's information systems and services function when he attended the 2012 Esri Asia Pacific User Conference in Auckland. Esri recorded his assessment of the event's practical and technical content, especially its relevance to community-based conservation.
